arStrings.szText: Tharra seeks the Oracle's path to heal the divide among the daughters of Skovos.

Tharra said she would seek the next part of her Passage in Philios. When I returned to Vision's End to rejoin her, she had already departed, leaving an Amazon Messenger in her place. 

I should speak with this Messenger. She seems eager to deliver her charge.

The messenger told me that Tharra has gone up the mountain to seek the Oracle's guidance. They wait atop Mount Karcheus, within the Sanctum of the Eye.

I must climb and meet them there.
Tharra told me she would pursue the second part of her Passage in Philios. I should make my way to Vision's End and rejoin her there.
I have found the Oracle and Tharra atop Mount Karcheus. They appeared deep in counsel, but Tharra noticed my arrival. She wishes to speak with me.

The Oracle told Tharra that the first step toward healing the rift between their orders is for her to walk the Oracle Path. This pilgrimage throughout Philios is marked by three sacred shrines across the island.

The first of them is the Trial of Clay. Tharra and I will make the journey together.

The Oracle told Tharra that the first step toward healing the rift between their orders is for her to walk the Oracle Path. This pilgrimage throughout Philios is marked by three sacred shrines across the island.

The first of them is the Trial of Clay. Tharra wants to speak with me about what must be done.
The first trial on the Oracle's path is a modest rite. Tharra and I must inscribe our names upon the Wall of Names, affirming that we have stood here and will begin the journey.

Our first trial is behind us. Tharra is shaken. Her former mentor once walked this same path many years ago, yet abandoned every oath she swore. Tharra has not spoken of it aloud, but it is clear she has not come to terms with Adreona's betrayal.

Even so, she steels herself and moves on to the second trial - the Trial of Life.

Our first trial is behind us. Tharra is shaken. Her former mentor once walked this same path many years ago, yet abandoned every oath she swore. 

Even so, she steels herself and moves on to the second trial--the Trial of Life. There is a tablet here we should investigate before continuing.

The tablet at the Trial of Life states that any who walk this pilgrimage must give of themselves to the land. At the foot of the falls stands a ritual bowl. Tharra opened her hand and let her blood mingle with the waters to fulfill the rite. 

I must do the same to begin the trial.

As my blood fell into the ritual bowl, the Trial of Life answered. The Guardians of the Land rose around us, challenging our right to walk this path. 

We must defeat them to prove our worth.

The Trial of Life has been fulfilled. The Guardians rest once more, and the ritual flames have been kindled in their honor. 

I must speak with Tharra before we proceed to the final trial.

The first trial on the Oracle's path is a modest rite. Tharra and I must inscribe our names upon the Wall of Names, affirming that we have stood here and will begin the journey. 

Tharra appeared solemn as she wrote her name on the Wall. I should ask about what troubles her.

Tharra and I set out for the final site of the Oracle pilgrimage: the Trial of Sight.

Whatever vision or test awaits there , we shall discover in time.

Tharra and I reached the Trial of Sight, only to find ruin. Dead Seers lie broken on the ground, and the sacred shrine is destroyed. A handful of Seers remain, struggling to clear away the blood and debris.

One of them cried out in anger at our arrival, perhaps mistaking us for the culprits. I must speak with Gaiana and set the record straight.

Seer Gaiana claims the corrupted Amazons are to blame, but she spares no anger on Tharra. If Adreona had been dealt with sooner, these horrors might never have happened. She demands a blood price for what was lost.

The past cannot be changed, but her words have clearly affected Tharra. I must speak with her.

Seer Gaiana claims the corrupted Amazons are to blame, but she spares no anger on Tharra. If Adreona had been dealt with sooner, these horrors might never have happened. She demands a blood price for what was lost.

The fallen Amazons fled to the south of Philios. Gaiana commanded we come back only when their eyes are claimed.
Tharra has completed the Trial of Sight, such as it is. With all three parts of the pilgrimage fulfilled, we should return to Oracle Cyra at Mount Karcheus.

Tharra has received Oracle Cyra's blessing, and the second part of her Passage is now fulfilled. Yet Cyra noted that the wound of Adreona's betrayal is still raw. She told us the path to healing begins in the Cavern of Echoes.

I should speak with Tharra and hear her thoughts.

Seer Gaiana's blood price is paid. The corrupted Amazons who wrought such devastation now lie dead, though I fear they are only a fraction of those still haunting Skovos.

Tharra and I must return the eyes to Gaiana at the Sight of Sorrows. May they grant her the peace she seeks.
